issues.description: G4 env-loop test uses MockSimulatorSession with patched Observation.from_world instead of a real SimulatorSession. Real-session integration requires a scenario fixture (scenario_dict or scenario_path) compatible with sc2_simulator's ScenarioDefinition. The full_game_replay.py build flow depends on map data + wave specs + MissionEngine which are too heavy for unit tests.
issues.mitigation: SimulatorRlBackend code path is identical for mock and real sessions; real session only differs in Observation.from_world output richness
